headline: GOLD $4,377 AND SILVER $70 HOLD INTO IRAN DEAL SIGNING TOMORROW — STRUCTURAL BID CONFIRMS BULL MARKET ISN'T FEAR-DRIVEN
snippet: Gold held at $4,377 and silver at $70.42 heading into Wednesday's session even as the US-Iran interim peace accord is set for formal signature in Switzerland on June 19 — an outcome that sent oil down 4% to a two-month low, which classical risk-on models would predict pressures precious metals as the energy-inflation panic subsides. The rally is defying that framework because the primary bid is structural, not fear-driven: Q1 2026 saw 244 tonnes of net central bank buying independent of equity direction, and the Silver Institute projects a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit of 46.3 million ounces even as the Iran deal removes the short-cycle inflation premium from the trade.

headline: SLAM DRILLS 30m MASSIVE SULPHIDE AT GOODWIN — Cu-Ni-Co VTEM CONDUCTOR CONFIRMED IN BATHURST CAMP NEW BRUNSWICK
source_name: Investing News Network / SLAM Exploration Ltd. (TSXV: SXL)
snippet: SLAM Exploration Ltd. (TSXV: SXL) reported June 17, 2026 that drill hole GW26-29 intersected over 30 metres of massive sulphide mineralization — including a 26.10-metre core interval from 18.70 to 44.80 m — while testing a VTEM conductor on the 14,000-hectare Goodwin copper-nickel-cobalt project in New Brunswick's Bathurst Mining Camp, one of Canada's most established base-metal districts. All four holes drilled to date in the 7,000-metre program have targeted models from a January 2026 VTEM survey that identified 432 anomalies across 24 conductor plate models; assay results for GW26-29 are pending, making the structural scale of this intercept — confirmed massive sulphide beneath a geophysical target — the critical signal for investors.

headline: BRIXTON LANGIS: 23.7m AT 206.6 g/t Ag IN COBALT ONTARIO — PEAK 1,798 g/t AS 60,000m RESOURCE CAMPAIGN BUILDS TOWARD ESTIMATE
snippet: Brixton Metals Corp. (TSXV: BBB) released June 16, 2026 drill results from its Langis Silver Project in the historic Cobalt silver mining camp of northern Ontario — highlighted by hole LM-26-342 returning 23.70 metres grading 206.6 g/t silver (including 4.30 metres at 906 g/t Ag and 1.80 metres at 1,329 g/t Ag), and hole LM-26-355 intersecting 4.95 metres at 492.8 g/t Ag with a 1.0-metre peak of 1,798 g/t Ag. Brixton has now completed 18,678 metres across 90 holes in 2026 with a second drill rig now operational to reach the 60,000-metre target — a resource-definition campaign at silver's highest prices since early 2026 ($70.42/oz) in one of Ontario's best-documented historical silver camps that has not hosted modern resource-grade drilling.

headline: REGENCY SILVER DIOS PADRE: 5.06 g/t Au + 41.85 g/t Ag OVER 36m — THREE-METAL BRECCIA EXTENDS 775m IN SONORA
snippet: Regency Silver Corp. (TSXV: RSMX) released complete results from its 2025/2026 drill campaign at the Dios Padre Project near Yecora, Sonora on June 16, 2026 — highlighted by hole REG-26-35 returning 36.35 metres grading 5.06 g/t gold, 41.85 g/t silver, and 1.10% copper within a broader 96-metre zone averaging 2.08 g/t Au, confirming high-grade multi-metal mineralisation at depth in a step-out. The primary breccia body has now been confirmed over approximately 775 metres down-plunge, with the high-grade core now defined at ~150m × 75m × 50m — still open at depth — positioning Dios Padre as one of the most active high-grade gold-silver-copper breccia systems in Mexico at current precious metal prices.

headline: TIGER GOLD HITS 234.5m AT 1.2 g/t Au AT TESORITO — BEST HOLES EVER DRILLED DOUBLE COLOMBIA DEPOSIT'S RESOURCE GRADE
source_name: Value The Markets / Tiger Gold Corp. (TSXV: TIGR)
snippet: Tiger Gold Corp. (TSXV: TIGR) reported June 16, 2026 the strongest drill results in the company's history at the Tesorito deposit within its Quinchía Gold Project in Colombia's Mid-Cauca gold belt — hole TSDH-88 returned 234.54 metres at 1.2 g/t Au and TSDH-87 returned 180.3 metres at 1.0 g/t Au, both from near surface, more than doubling the deposit's existing 0.47 g/t Au average Inferred Resource grade. Both holes are positioned within the Tesorito resource envelope and will feed directly into a year-end 2026 Mineral Resource update designed to convert a significant portion of the current Inferred inventory to Indicated and inform 2027 engineering studies, consistent with the trajectory of the company's 20,000-metre 2026 program.

headline: EMPEROR/GLOBEX DRILLS 61.5 g/t Au OVER 15m AT DUQUESNE WEST — VISIBLE GOLD AS 23,000m ABITIBI PROGRAM ADVANCES
source_name: Manila Times / Emperor Metals Inc. (CSE: AUEX) via Globex Mining (TSX: GMX)
snippet: Emperor Metals Inc. (CSE: AUEX) reported June 16, 2026 that hole DQ 26-20 within the conceptual Main Pit at the Duquesne West gold property in Quebec's Abitibi intersected 61.5 g/t Au over 15.0 metres with several occurrences of visible gold — the latest high-grade result from a 2026 program combining 15,000 metres of new drilling with 8,000 metres of targeted resampling of historical drill core (23,000 metres total). Duquesne West, held under option from Duparquet Assets Ltd. and 50% owned by Globex Mining (TSX: GMX), is being drilled to define extensive low-grade bulk-tonnage zones surrounding the known high-grade cores — a geometry that supports the development of a district-scale open-pit constrained resource model in a jurisdiction where Agnico Eagle's Canadian Malartic sets the benchmark for bulk Abitibi gold production.

headline: SOUTH PACIFIC METALS OPENS MEGABE IN PNG — 12m AT 3.1 g/t Au ADJACENT TO K92 KORA-JUDD AS DISTRICT DRILL PROGRAM EXPANDS
source_name: Investing News Network / South Pacific Metals Corp. (TSXV: SPMC)
snippet: South Pacific Metals Corp. (TSXV: SPMC) reported June 16, 2026 that the first hole at its new Megabe target (ONED26-007) at Ontenu NE within the Osena Project in Papua New Guinea returned 12 metres at 3.1 g/t Au, including 1 metre at 18.1 g/t Au, from a NW-SE-striking fault breccia hosted in metasediments — a geological host and orientation directly comparable to K92 Mining's adjacent Kora-Judd operations. With two diamond drills now turning at Ontenu NE while targeting is being finalised at the adjacent Ontenu Central prospect, South Pacific Metals is advancing a multi-target district exploration campaign on the same mineralised corridor that has produced K92's multi-million-ounce inventory — one of the most prolific active discovery corridors in the Pacific.

headline: TROILUS CONNECTOR ZONE: 1.15 g/t AuEQ OVER 37m — MINE PLAN OPTIMIZATION CONFIRMS HIGH GRADES IN EARLY-MINING ZONE
snippet: Troilus Gold Corp. (TSX: TLG) released June 16, 2026 drill results from the Connector Zone at its Troilus Gold Project in north-central Quebec — hole TLG-26-1068 returned 37 metres at 1.15 g/t AuEQ (0.91 g/t Au, 3.23 g/t Ag, 0.13% Cu), including 5 metres at 3.84 g/t AuEQ — extending high-grade mineralisation within the area slated for early-stage mining in the current mine plan. The Connector Zone program is designed to convert Inferred to Indicated within the Z87-J pit area and supports mine plan optimization by confirming that the up-plunge extension of the Z87-J high-grade corridor carries the grade continuity required for early cash-flow generation in the project's development sequence.

headline: ARIZONA GOLD & SILVER WINS BLM PERMIT — 16 NEW DRILL PADS APPROVED AT PHILADELPHIA AHEAD OF 2+ YEAR EXPANSION PROGRAM
source_name: Investing News Network / Arizona Gold & Silver Inc. (TSXV: AZS)
snippet: Arizona Gold & Silver Inc. (TSXV: AZS) announced June 16, 2026 that the US Bureau of Land Management approved modifications to its Exploration Plan at the Philadelphia Gold-Silver Project in northwestern Arizona — authorising 16 new drill pads, associated sumps, and access roads with approximately 14 acres of total disturbance, classified as a minor modification to the existing plan. Management anticipates more than two years of active drilling ahead following the permit, advancing a gold-silver project in a US jurisdiction where BLM approvals have historically proven to be a meaningful de-risking catalyst for junior mining equity valuations in the current regulatory environment.

headline: ABRASILVER LA COIPITA: 748m AT 0.69% Cu IN ARGENTINA — DISTRICT-SCALE PORPHYRY POTENTIAL OPENS NEW TARGET 1.9km SOUTH
snippet: Mining.com reported that AbraSilver Resource Corp. (TSX: ABRA) completed its 2026 drill program at the La Coipita copper-gold-molybdenum project in San Juan Province, Argentina — with the strongest result to date, DDH-LC26-010, returning 747.5 metres at 0.69% Cu, 0.06 g/t Au, and 142 ppm Mo from 396 metres, confirming a large-tonnage porphyry system at depth. The program also hit 42 metres at 1.03% Cu, 0.63 g/t Au, and 41 g/t Ag at the new Yaretas Sur target 1.9 km south of the main Yaretas drilling area — opening a second mineralized centre that, combined with the main 747-metre intercept, positions La Coipita as a district-scale copper porphyry story in one of the world's premier copper jurisdictions at COMEX copper near $6.51/lb.

headline: HAMILTON: GOLD ENTERS DOLDRUMS BUT AUTUMN SETUP IS MOST BULLISH IN YEARS — OVERBOUGHT RESET CLEARS PATH FOR RALLY
snippet: Adam Hamilton's latest GoldSeek analysis documents gold entering the June-July seasonal doldrums — historically the weakest period of the year — but argues the current setup is the most bullish in several years because gold has just corrected to its least-overbought levels since the bull began, with gold-futures speculators and American stock investors both carrying significant room to re-add positions. Hamilton's seasonal framework shows that 2001–2025 gold autumn rallies averaged 5.5% gains into late September and winter rallies averaged 7.9% into late February — and that June-July doldrum weakness has historically been the optimal accumulation window for investors positioned ahead of the seasonal acceleration.

headline: METALS FOCUS: GOLD BULL MARKET HAS LEGS INTO 2027 — $4,920/oz 2026 AVERAGE PROJECTED WITH RECORD UPSIDE SCENARIO
snippet: GoldSeek's summary of Metals Focus's Gold Focus 2026 report projects a record $4,920/oz average gold price for 2026, with the research firm maintaining a bullish stance based on sustained central bank accumulation, persistent de-dollarisation flows, and the structural demand shift that makes the current bull cycle fundamentally different from the 2011-2020 consolidation period. Metals Focus identifies ongoing geopolitical uncertainty — including US postures toward Venezuela and Greenland alongside the Iran resolution — as factors that underpin continued central bank diversification regardless of near-term rate policy shifts, supporting the thesis that gold's structural floor has materially risen since 2022.
